product.title: Napa Valley Wine Trolley Castle Tour

description.text: Experience Napa Valley on the Wine Trolley Castle Tour heading north to Calistoga. The route includes Castello di Amorosa for an extensive tasting, lunch at Tre Vigne Pizzeria, and two additional notable Napa Valley wineries aboard an open-air cable car replica.

highlights: Up-valley Napa Wine Trolley route to Calistoga
Castello di Amorosa castle winery tasting stop
Included lunch at Tre Vigne Pizzeria
Two additional Napa Valley winery visits

start.description: Meet at Oxbow Public Market, 610 1st St, Napa, CA 94559 for trolley pickup.

end.description: Return to the Oxbow Public Market meeting point in Napa.
